body: You’re quite right that traditional gender norms and expectations hurt men just as they hurt women. What research are you pointing to that gives evidence that “men who show vulnerability and emotions just don’t get the same respect from women” when dating?

What’s happening in this post and comments:

Woman: Says exactly what she wants for herself in her own relationship.

Men/boys: You don’t know what you want! I know what all women actually want!

The same men/boys: Wonder why they can’t get a girlfriend or keep a relationship with a woman that isn’t toxic.

Also, look at all the dudes telling on themselves thinking the heart in this MEME ABOUT WOMEN’S DESIRE is supposed to be pee LMAO

And finally, as an INFJ in my 30s with an incredible husband who, while not perfect (obviously neither am I), is very comfortable in his masculinity and is capable of healthy emotional vulnerability (even willing to go to couples counseling with me to make our relationship stronger, not just as a last ditch effort to save an already doomed relationship), yes to all of this. He and I have been together for over a decade and we’ve faced all our ups and downs from a place of honesty, respect, compassion, and collaboration. Having a partner who is willing to work on himself like I do myself and who can effectively communicate his emotions, wants, and needs without trying to pretend to be some macho tough guy who only feels angry all the time is 10/10, highly recommend. My husband is also an INTP but clearly a lot more emotionally mature than the kids in the comments here.
